name: steps
title: Steps
description: Numbered indicators with connecting separators, prev/next triggers, per-step content, and a completed state — for wizard-style flows.

props.name: defaultStep
props.description:
The initial value of the stepper when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the stepper.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The custom ids for the stepper elements

props.name: isStepSkippable
props.description:
Whether a step can be skipped during navigation.
Skippable steps are bypassed when using next/prev.

props.name: isStepValid
props.description: Whether a step is valid. Invalid steps block forward navigation in linear mode.

props.name: linear
props.description: If `true`, the stepper requires the user to complete the steps in order

props.name: onStepComplete
props.description: Callback to be called when a step is completed

props.name: step
props.description: The controlled value of the stepper

events.name: onStepChange
events.description: Callback to be called when the value changes

events.name: onStepInvalid
events.description: Called when navigation is blocked due to an invalid step.

examples.title: Horizontal
examples.source:
import Steps from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/steps/steps.marko"; static const WIZARD_STEPS = [ { title: "Account", description: "Provide your account details" }, { title: "Profile", description: "Tell us about yourself" }, { title: "Review", description: "Confirm and finish" }, ];

Step ${index + 1}: ${WIZARD_STEPS[index]?.title} content goes here.

<@completedContent>

All steps complete — thanks!
